entities.summary: Achadas da Cruz is a civil parish in the municipality of Porto Moniz in the Portuguese island of Madeira. The population in 2011 was 159, in an area of 7.88 km2. It is situated on the north-western coast of the island. No children were born in the parish between 2001 and 2009.
